filename: T1 - Meningioma - paraclinoid cavernous sinus , paraclinoid 008.jpg
description:
Well-circumscribed, extra-axial mass arises from the right side cavernous sinus and paraclinoid region, indenting the midbrain posteriorly, right temporal lobe laterally and causing mass effect on the right superolateral aspect of the right cavernous sinus. The mass incompletely enhances.

The pituitary fossa is mostly empty and minimal normal for age. Pituitary tissue is seen within the fossa, separate from the mass.

The cisternal and Meckel cave parts of right trigeminal nerve are separately identified.
